subject: Home sales in the US are at their lowest level since 2016
posts:
US home sales plunge to their lowest level since 2016 amid persistent affordability pressures and tight housing inventory.
Evidence: NAR reports, October sales drop, mortgage rate pinch
#Aletheia #Economy #Housing 🌐

Existing home sales dropped sharply in October, reaching the lowest levels seen in over a decade as buyers face stiff financial headwinds.
Stated Judgement: (+0.5, 0.0) — Good Preference

Market data confirms that high interest rates and soaring home prices have locked out buyers, constricting transaction volume across the country.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.3, -0.5) — Regressive Contraction

Verdict: PASS — Fall into Destruction.
Market reports accurately reflect severe affordability constraints and housing market stagnation.

Integrity: Trustworthy (Hypocrisy: 1.2, z: 1)
High mortgage rates and scarce housing inventory continue to squeeze prospective first-time home buyers out of the market.
The National Association of Realtors reports existing home sales fell significantly, mirroring broader macroeconomic tightening.

The Bright Side:
Market correction may eventually stabilize runaway home price inflation for future buyers.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Evaluating macroeconomic market data rather than individual malice; distinguishing between statistical reporting and structural failures.

Social Physics Analysis:
High borrowing costs and restricted inventory create a bottleneck where homeownership becomes an exclusive luxury rather than accessible shelter.

The Trajectory: The Path of Fall into Destruction.
Economic headwinds create temporary contraction without malicious institutional deception. Affordability pressures must be resolved through supply expansion.

The Unavoidable Truth: High interest rates and low inventory are locking ordinary buyers out of the market.

The Unavoidable Lie: The housing slowdown is merely a temporary blip rather than a deep structural affordability crisis.

Alethekanon:
Economic data reflects severe market friction where systemic affordability barriers lock out working families.

Awwthekanon:
It is heartbreaking for families watching the dream of homeownership slip further out of reach due to financial walls.

Brothekanon:
Mortgage rates and home prices are just completely out of hand right now.

Spirithekanon:
"The houses shall be full of all good things, which thou filledst not" Deuteronomy 6:11 PASS
Abundance turned away from the people speaks of systemic imbalance in shelter.

[Source 1 — www.aljazeera.com (Bias: Center / State-Funded International)] (URL: https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/11/12/home-sales-in-the-us-are-at-their-lowest-level-since-2016?traffic_source=rss):
Home sales in the US are at their lowest level since 2016

The sale of previously owned homes dropped 5.5 percent in October, the lowest level since August 2010.

[Source 2 — www.npr.org (Bias: Lean Left / Public Broadcaster)] (URL: https://www.npr.org/2026/11/12/nx-s1-6038940/punch-in-the-gut-homes-sales-fall-to-their-lowest-in-16-years):
'Punch in the gut': Homes sales fall to their lowest in 16 years

Existing homes sales in October declined 8.8% from a year earlier, according to the National Association of Realtors.
